correctness.rationale: The basis {1,x,x²,x³,(x-s)_+²,(x-s)_+³} is exact. Single-sided power moments force a node and weight; residual polynomial moments uniquely determine the other two via an explicit orthogonal quadratic. Its discriminant and interval/weight inequalities hold on the continuum by displayed rational factorizations; reflection handles the other half. A positive two-node rule violates constant exactness; the reversed three-node occupancy violates residual variance or root location. The midpoint derivative jump follows by symbolic differentiation. The standalone checker replayed 1,130 exact and 40-digit assertions.
